data.name: Rahan
data.gender_notes: Rahan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rahan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ra' which means 'Thunder'. This name is associated with the powerful and destructive forces of nature, symbolizing strength, courage and fearlessness. It is also believed to represent the divine protective energies of the universe. The name Rahan carries the meaning “Thunder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rahan usually hope their child will grow to embody thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rahan is a powerful and sacred name in Hinduism, associated with the gods of thunder and lightning. It is believed to bring strength, courage and protection to the bearer, and is often given to boys as a name with spiritual significance.
data.etymology: Rahan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thunder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
